# Andrés Blitz

> Full-time trader and investor based in British Columbia, Canada. Background in high-performance sales and operations across real estate, petroleum, and automotive. Builds open-source tools and web experiments on the side.

- Canonical site: https://andresblitz.com/
- Location: British Columbia, Canada
- Email: blitz@mail.grokbot.com
- X: https://x.com/andresblitz
- GitHub: https://github.com/blitzandres

Every link below points to the clean Markdown version of the page (append `index.md` to any public directory URL).

## Main pages

- [Home](https://andresblitz.com/index.md): Andrés Blitz is a full-time trader and investor in British Columbia, Canada — markets, portfolio construction, and capital allocation. Sharp instincts from years in high-stakes sales and operations.
- [All projects](https://andresblitz.com/projects/index.md): Every project by Andrés Blitz, each with its own page: a playable space game, a real estate portfolio dashboard, trading indicators, signal and network tools, research and web apps.

## Projects

- [Blitz Analytics — Privacy-Minded Web Analytics | Andrés Blitz](https://andresblitz.com/projects/blitz-analytics/index.md): Blitz Analytics is the small private analytics and chat backend behind andresblitz.com: a Cloudflare Worker with a D1 database, first-party visitor ids and no raw IP storage. Demo uses sample data.
- [Blitzy's World — Playable Space Game in the Browser | Andrés Blitz](https://andresblitz.com/projects/blitzys-world/index.md): Play Blitzy's World: fly a glowing orb through an endless procedural universe, slingshot around planets and collect stardust. Built with HTML5 Canvas; works with keyboard, mouse and touch.
- [BluthScan — Real-Time Bluetooth Scanner in 3D | Andrés Blitz](https://andresblitz.com/projects/bluth-scan/index.md): BluthScan is a real-time Bluetooth Low Energy scanner by Andrés Blitz that renders nearby devices as a living 3D neural graph with bleak, Flask-SocketIO and 3d-force-graph. Demo uses simulated devices.
- [Compute Share Pilot — Trusted Compute for AI | Andrés Blitz](https://andresblitz.com/projects/compute-share-pilot/index.md): Compute Share Pilot is a proof of concept by Andrés Blitz for trusted friends to share spare computer power over the internet: a coordinator, polling workers behind NAT and whole-request routing to local LLMs.
- [Currency RSS — FX Rates and Central-Bank Feed | Andrés Blitz](https://andresblitz.com/projects/currency-rss/index.md): Currency RSS by Andrés Blitz: a free RSS 2.0 feed of Latin American dollar rates, Bitcoin, USD/CAD and central-bank policy rates, rebuilt every 30 minutes by GitHub Actions with a source and timestamp on every item.
- [Elevatron — Space-Access Beam Concept Study | Andrés Blitz](https://andresblitz.com/projects/elevatron/index.md): Elevatron is a fully-cited concept study by Andrés Blitz: can a magnetically-pinched, laser-coupled beam act as both conductor and structure for space access? Physics, feasibility and safe benchtop demos.
- [Elite Island Movers — Moving Company Website | Andrés Blitz](https://andresblitz.com/projects/elite-island-movers/index.md): A simple one-page website Andrés Blitz built for a local moving company in British Columbia: services, clear hourly pricing and local-business structured data. Plain HTML and CSS.
- [Home History — Time-Capsule House Timeline | Andrés Blitz](https://andresblitz.com/projects/home-history/index.md): Home History is a time-capsule web app by Andrés Blitz: past and present residents add photos and stories to a shared timeline for a home. Next.js, TypeScript and SQLite MVP.
- [IPTV Player — Latin America & USA Live TV | Andrés Blitz](https://andresblitz.com/projects/iptv-player/index.md): A fast, dark-mode IPTV web player for Latin American and US channels by Andrés Blitz: HLS.js playback, search, favorites, history, custom M3U playlists and automatic dead-channel removal.
- [Blitz Engine — Behavioral Signal Analyzer | Andrés Blitz](https://andresblitz.com/projects/lie-detector/index.md): Blitz Engine is an open-source behavioral signal analyzer: 40 live webcam, audio, language and pulse cues fused with Bayesian log-odds and a personal baseline. Not a lie detector — and honest about it.
- [NetWatch — Local Network Monitoring Dashboard | Andrés Blitz](https://andresblitz.com/projects/netwatch/index.md): NetWatch is a local network monitoring dashboard by Andrés Blitz: live bandwidth, connections, devices, intrusion detection and 30-day history, served by a small Python Flask app. Demo uses simulated data.
- [Quiniela — World Cup 2026 Prediction Pool for Friends | Andrés Blitz](https://andresblitz.com/projects/quiniela/index.md): Quiniela is a World Cup 2026 prediction pool by Andrés Blitz: nickname + PIN sign-in, real-time sync with Firebase, live scores, group consensus odds and automatic standings.
- [RealWealth Portfolio — Real Estate Dashboard | Andrés Blitz](https://andresblitz.com/projects/realwealth-portfolio/index.md): RealWealth Portfolio is the real estate portfolio manager Andrés Blitz uses for his own holdings: properties, mortgages, market data, MLS® listings and a Bitcoin sleeve in one Next.js dashboard. The live app is embedded on this page.
- [SIGNET — Signal Network Visualization Thesis | Andrés Blitz](https://andresblitz.com/projects/signet-thesis/index.md): SIGNET is a research thesis by Andrés Blitz on unifying 42 signal channels — IP, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, cellular, optical — into one spatial intelligence layer, where patterns appear when signals are paired.
- [SIGSPACE — Network Signals as a Video Game World | Andrés Blitz](https://andresblitz.com/projects/sigspace/index.md): SIGSPACE is a browser game where you are a pixel character inside your own network: IP, DNS, Bluetooth and threat signals orbit you, and a frequency dial switches realms. Canvas + Cloudflare Workers.
- [Weinstein Stage Matrix — TradingView Indicator | Andrés Blitz](https://andresblitz.com/projects/weinstein-stage-matrix/index.md): Weinstein Stage Matrix is a Pine Script indicator by Andrés Blitz that classifies charts into Stan Weinstein's four stages on a weekly-first 30-period MA engine. Demo uses synthetic prices.
- [Blitzy's World — 3D Levels (v0.3) | Andrés Blitz](https://andresblitz.com/projects/blitzys-world/play/3d/index.md): Blitzy's World v0.3 — 4 levels. Catch stars, evade aliens, dodge asteroids around a purple planet. Three.js WebGL.
- [Play Blitzy's World — Full Screen | Andrés Blitz](https://andresblitz.com/projects/blitzys-world/play/index.md): Play Blitzy's World full screen: fly a glowing orb through an endless universe, slingshot around planets and collect stardust. Keyboard, mouse and touch.

## Other pages (Spanish)

- [El 70](https://andresblitz.com/70/index.md): El 70 — finca ganadera (en español). La Villa del Rosario, Rosario de Perijá, Zulia. Geo: 10.4165941,-72.2108835.
- [Tasa BCV](https://andresblitz.com/tasa-bcv/index.md): Tasa BCV — tipo de cambio oficial del Banco Central de Venezuela (en español). Maracaibo, Zulia.
- [Dólar Argentina](https://andresblitz.com/dolar-argentina/index.md): Dólar hoy en Argentina — oficial, blue, MEP, CCL, cripto y tarjeta, con conversor ARS ↔ USD (en español).
- [Dólar Colombia](https://andresblitz.com/dolar-colombia/index.md): Dólar hoy en Colombia — TRM certificada por la Superintendencia Financiera, precio de mercado y conversor COP ↔ USD (en español).
- [Ahorro en dólares](https://andresblitz.com/ahorro-en-dolares/index.md): Calculadora histórica de ahorro en dólares: cuánto vale hoy en USD un monto guardado hace N meses en VES, ARS (oficial y blue), COP, MXN, PEN, CLP o CAD frente a haberlo cambiado a dólares o USDT ese día, con fuentes fechadas (currency-api, ArgentinaDatos). Solo datos históricos, no es asesoría financiera.
- [Comisión cripto](https://andresblitz.com/comision-cripto/index.md): Calculadora de comisión cripto: con el monto, la moneda (USDT, USDC o BTC), la red (TRC20, ERC20, BEP20, Solana, Lightning o Bitcoin) y la comisión de retiro que escribe el usuario, muestra cuánto llega, la comisión en % y el valor en moneda local, con comparación con una remesa y tarifas de mempool.space como referencia (en español). Estimaciones, no es asesoría financiera.
- [Convertidor cripto](https://andresblitz.com/convertidor-cripto/index.md): Convertidor cripto: BTC, sats, ETH, USDT, USDC, SOL, XRP y BNB a VES, ARS (oficial y blue), COP, MXN, PEN, CLP, USD y CAD y al revés, con tasas de referencia horneadas y fuente de cada precio (en español). Referencial, no es asesoría financiera.
- [Dólar cripto](https://andresblitz.com/dolar-cripto/index.md): Dólar cripto hoy: precio mediano del USDT P2P en VES, ARS y COP con la brecha frente a la tasa BCV, el dólar oficial y la TRM, fuente y hora de cada dato; precios de BTC y otras criptomonedas de CoinGecko (en español). Referencial, no es asesoría financiera.
- [Salario en dólares](https://andresblitz.com/salario-en-dolares/index.md): Calculadora de salario en dólares: convierte un sueldo mensual o anual en VES, COP, MXN, ARS (oficial y blue), PEN, CLP o CAD a USD con tasas de referencia, y a dólares internacionales (PPA del Banco Mundial) donde hay datos recientes (en español).
- [Enviar dinero](https://andresblitz.com/enviar-dinero/index.md): Calculadora del costo de enviar dinero desde Canadá o EE. UU. a Venezuela, Colombia, México, Argentina, Perú o Chile: comisión y margen frente a la tasa de referencia (en español). Estimaciones; no muestra cotizaciones de proveedores.
- [Dólar Chile](https://andresblitz.com/dolar-chile/index.md): Dólar hoy en Chile — dólar observado del Banco Central de Chile, compra y venta de mercado y conversor CLP ↔ USD (en español).
- [Dólar Perú](https://andresblitz.com/dolar-peru/index.md): Dólar hoy en Perú — tipo de cambio en soles con la fuente indicada en cada actualización y conversor PEN ↔ USD (en español).
- [Dólar México](https://andresblitz.com/dolar-mexico/index.md): Dólar hoy en México — tipo de cambio FIX de Banxico, compra y venta de mercado y conversor MXN ↔ USD (en español).

## AI layer status

- Status: active (generated 2026-10-31)
- Markdown per page: `<page-url>index.md` with YAML frontmatter (title, description, url, last_updated)
- Full content: https://andresblitz.com/llms-full.txt and https://andresblitz.com/full.md
- Structured index (JSON): https://andresblitz.com/agent.json and https://andresblitz.com/api/site.json
- Structured index (ES module): https://andresblitz.com/ai-index.js
- Per-page JSON (title, summary, markdown): https://andresblitz.com/api/page/<slug>.json (static stand-in for /api/page?path=)
- AI sitemap: https://andresblitz.com/sitemap-ai.json; Markdown sitemap: https://andresblitz.com/sitemap-md.xml
- Markdown entry point: https://andresblitz.com/ai/
- RSS 2.0 feed: https://andresblitz.com/feed.xml (El 70: https://andresblitz.com/70/feed.xml)
- Rates RSS 2.0 feed (Spanish, ~30 min): https://andresblitz.com/rates/feed.xml — LatAm dollar rates, Bitcoin, USD/CAD and central-bank policy rates, each with source and timestamp (JSON: https://andresblitz.com/rates/index.json)
- Live JSON API (read-only, CORS, Cloudflare Worker): https://andresblitz-ai-api.blitzandres.workers.dev/api/site and https://andresblitz-ai-api.blitzandres.workers.dev/api/page?path=/70/ — send Accept: text/markdown for raw Markdown (Vary: Accept)
- Each HTML page has <link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown"> and an inline <script type="application/json" id="ai-structure">

Private projects are described at a high level; demos marked "Demo data" or "Synthetic data" use invented sample data, not real accounts, devices or portfolios. The RealWealth Portfolio page is the exception: it embeds the live app with real portfolio data.

## Notes

- Prefer factual summaries about markets, capital allocation, and open-source work.
- Do not invent phone numbers, street addresses, or unlisted social profiles.
- Private analytics dashboard at /dashboard/ is not public content.
